scope: End-to-end proportion and look review of every vehicle model (road vehicles, motorhomes, transit, cycles, watercraft, aircraft) against public-domain and Creative Commons photographs and three-view drawings.
method: Calibrated overlays: each model was rendered with a camera matched to a reference photo (perspective) or drawing (orthographic) and aligned by two known points (wheel hubs, nose/tail tips); landmarks were read in metres. Proportion score = 100 x (1 - mean relative landmark error), heights relative to overall height and longitudinal positions relative to length; target >= 96 with no landmark above 6 %. Scores are indicative: reference read-off precision is about +/-0.02-0.1 m depending on the photograph.
